paragraphs.source_en: Toyotomi Hideyoshi announced that his younger sister, Lady Asahi, would leave Osaka on the twenty-eighth day of the fourth month of Tenshō 14 to marry into the Tokugawa family. On the night before her departure, he intended to have every street and alley in Osaka hung with celebratory lanterns. The owners of shops large and small treated their nearby relatives to lavish dinners and gave their clerks leave so that they could see off the bridal procession the following day.
